DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN).

The presence of leukocyturia alongside binucleated eosinophilic cells (eosinophiluria) in the urine of a patient with flank pain and fever following recent antibiotic treatment is highly specific for drug-induced hypersensitivity affecting the kidneys. Do you have any known allergies or history of rash after taking medications in the past?
